title: Amounts stated by Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera — October 9, 2026
intro: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera, a lawyer and CPA appearing as the prosecution’s financial expert, discussed bank balances, income reconciliation, corporate-interest estimates, policies, property and historical transactions during his direct examination in the Senate impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte on October 9, 2026.
scope: Material monetary amounts stated or explicitly confirmed by Cabrera in the reviewed Session 37 transcript. Figures stated solely by counsel, senator-judges or the BIR witness are excluded.
hearing_title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte (Oct. 9, 2026- 1:30 PM)
hearing_description: On October 9, 2026, Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera, lawyer and CPA appearing as the prosecution financial expert witness in the Senate impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte, presented his Article II financial review. The rows distinguish year-end balances, annual flows, report components and totals, estimated ownership interests, policy coverage and premiums, exclusions and historical transactions. Components overlap their totals, and successive stages can describe the same funds; the rows must not be added together.
